basis.note: Machine-readable working draft for synthetic preparation only. Not approved. Every field marked UNRESOLVED needs a Claude/Codex/Vivek decision before any freeze.

freeze_requirements.note: No approval ID exists. None is invented. Any scorer must refuse confirmatory scoring and PASS output until a freeze record matching this digest's successor is supplied.

clocks.invariant: A <= C <= t(S0) < t(S1), every term with its clock id

clock_uncertainty_policy.value: t_obs - u_obs >= C and A + u_A <= C when clocks differ

clocks.absent_feed_ts_policy: S0_UNTIMED / S1_UNTIMED: excluded from confirmation, retained as exploratory diagnostics

L1.evidence: device-clock available_at in immutable on-device envelope

L2.evidence: server-assigned receipt time bound to anchored content before C
L2.blocked_by: G-3: M0 research_m0 migration unapplied; no authenticated ingest path

forecast_record.config_identity_definition: sha256 of canonical JSON of STATIC configuration values and dependency/input-contract identities on the verdict path (executionMode, evExperimentMode, feature flags, constants). Changing market observations are NOT part of it; they live in input_provenance per forecast.
forecast_record.legacy_inference: FORBIDDEN: market_direction is never inferred from legacy direction, confidence or rounded scores
forecast_record.input_spots: per index NF and BNF separately: price, fetch_completed_at, feed_ts (nullable), clock_id, clock_uncertainty_s, source_id

status_axes.tie_treatment: scored 0 for rule and both baselines; not an exclusion

duplicates.index_scope: NF+BNF (one combined forecast record, expanded to NF and BNF evaluation rows AFTER duplicate resolution)

B_MAJ.even_split: most recent outcome sign in window
B_MAJ.eligibility: outcome fully resolved (S1 fetch time) before C
B_MAJ.note: TIE skipping makes warm-up depend on |r| (not sign); eligibility is not fully outcome-independent

B_TREND.definition: sign(S_dec - S_prev); S_dec = watermark poll spot; S_prev = previous regular session S1

session_aggregation.paired_rows: identical E_s for rule and both baselines

cohorts.default: separate cohorts per (source_kind, artifact identity, regime); no automatic pooling
cohorts.interventions: dated append-only intervention records; per-identity results retained

eligible_calendar.value: authoritative NSE calendar for covered years only

method.value: moving block bootstrap, b=5, joint index draw for both comparators, mean statistic, numpy quantile type 7

inference.gap_handling: evaluable sessions concatenated in order (modelling choice, NOT calendar-time equivalence); scheduled positions retained in audit

alpha_nominal.status: UNRESOLVED: 0.025 only provisionally calibrated within simulated families; see Grok OC report

authority: report file only; no effect on ranking, gates, sizing, exits, advice, mode, notifications or overrides
